title: Neon Crystal Ball Oracle
description: A glowing glass crystal ball sits on a dark starry pedestal, containing a bright neon pink and cyan electrical core with radiating beams. Inside the sphere, a stylized female profile with long eyelashes appears formed from glowing blue and purple light lines alongside swirling spiral patterns.
